svg.title: Isolated voltage path of a Nabd node
svg.desc: Signal chain from the wall outlet through a certified isolating AC-AC adapter, a resistor divider, a midscale bias, and the ADC to the DSP. The adapter's transformer is the isolation barrier between the mains side and the extra-low voltage node side.

svg.text: The only path to the grid is the transformer inside a certified adapter. The adapter carries only the divider current, below 0.2 mA.
